claim_boundary: This adapter computes an engineered causal temporal comparison from the benchmark's modeled left/right antenna transduction. It is not a measured neural signal, not a claim that MaleCNS contains this exact computation, and is not a controller input in the sealed v1 experiment.

direction_convention.definition: For each causal delay d, compare left(t-d)*right(t) against right(t-d)*left(t). Positive evidence means the left antenna led the right antenna at that delay.

scientific_controls: sealed v1 mean-odor interface remains unchanged
mirror left/right histories and require motion-evidence sign reversal
simultaneous bilateral pulses should produce near-zero direction evidence
prefix invariance proves future frames cannot change prior estimates
future v2 controller experiments must compare intact topology with equally optimized rewires and a temporal-information ablation
